partnershipPlan: Two former participants, one who completed and one who left after the third session, review the orientation call script and the follow-up questions; the interpreter service reviews the Portuguese and Tagalog materials.
socialListening: No social media listening; anonymised comments from the clinic's feedback forms over the last year are read for mentions of session times and travel.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I used up my leave on the first three Tuesdays and then there was nothing left.
items.implication: Record employment at referral and prioritise the evening group if hours are approved.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Two buses each way with my back is a whole morning, for a class about pacing.
items.implication: Offer the hybrid option from the first 2027 group.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My mother understood the exercises but not the talking parts, so she stopped going.
items.implication: Offer interpreters for the orientation call and translated summaries of each session.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The moment people realise someone else has the same pain is often week three, which is when they leave.
items.implication: Measure group connection and check it is not lost in video sessions.

summary: Four composite voices on work, travel, language and group connection.
